title: Combo IC-50 Serial Dilution of Compounds
author: Opentrons

steps.title: Set up labware
steps.instruction: Prepare labware: NEST 12‑well 15 mL reservoir in slot 1; Nest 96‑well 100 µL plates in slots 2, 4, 5, 7, 8, 10, 11; P20 filter tips in slot 3; P200 filter tips in slot 6.

steps.title: Transfer DMSO to vertical plate
steps.instruction: Using a P300 pipette, transfer VOL1 µL from the DMSO reservoir (slot 1) into wells B‑H of row 1/12 on the vertical stamp plate in slot 7; keep the tip.

steps.title: Transfer DMSO to horizontal plate
steps.instruction: Using a P300 pipette, transfer VOL2 µL from the DMSO reservoir (slot 1) into wells A2‑12/H2‑12 on the horizontal stamp plate in slot 8; discard the tip.

steps.title: Optional DMSO predilution to A2/11
steps.instruction: Using a P300 or P20 pipette, transfer VOL3/4 µL from the DMSO reservoir to wells A2 and A11 in slot 7 (optional steps 3‑6).

steps.title: Optional DMSO predilution to B1/G1
steps.instruction: Using a P300 or P20 pipette, transfer VOL5/6 µL from the DMSO reservoir to wells B1 and G1 in slot 8.

steps.title: Transfer compounds C/D
steps.instruction: Using a fresh P300/P20 tip, transfer VOL7/8 µL from wells B1 and B2 of the plate in slot 2 (compounds C and D) into wells A2 and A11 in slot 7.

steps.title: Transfer compounds A/B
steps.instruction: Using a fresh P300/P20 tip, transfer VOL9/10 µL from wells A1 and A2 of the plate in slot 2 (compounds A and B) into wells B1 and G1 in slot 8.

steps.title: Transfer VOL11 to A1
steps.instruction: Using a P300 (keep tip), transfer VOL11 µL from well B1 (slot 2) or, if optional predilution was performed, from well A2 (slot 7) into well A1 (slot 7); mix before transfer.

steps.title: Transfer VOL12 to B1
steps.instruction: Using a P300 (keep tip), transfer VOL12 µL from well A1 to well B1; mix after transfer.

steps.title: Serial transfer B1‑G1
steps.instruction: Using the same tip, repeat the transfer of VOL12 µL from each well to the next across the row: B1→C1, C1→D1, …, F1→G1; discard tip after the final transfer.

steps.title: Transfer VOL11 to A12
steps.instruction: Using a P300 (keep tip), transfer VOL11 µL from well B2 (slot 2) or, if optional predilution was performed, from well A11 (slot 7) into well A12 (slot 7); mix before transfer.

steps.title: Transfer VOL12 to B12
steps.instruction: Using a P300 (keep tip), transfer VOL12 µL from well A12 to well B12; mix after transfer.

steps.title: Serial transfer B12‑G12
steps.instruction: Using the same tip, repeat the transfer of VOL12 µL from B12→C12, C12→D12, …, F12→G12; discard tip after the final transfer.

steps.title: Transfer VOL13 to A1 (slot 8)
steps.instruction: Using a P300 (keep tip), transfer VOL13 µL from well A1 (slot 2) or, if optional predilution was performed, from well B1 (slot 8) into well A1 (slot 8); mix before transfer.

steps.title: Transfer VOL14 to A2
steps.instruction: Using a P300 (keep tip), transfer VOL14 µL from well A1 to well A2; mix after transfer.

steps.title: Serial tip disposal A2‑A11
steps.instruction: Repeat transfers from A2→A3, A3→A4, …, A10→A11; discard tip after the final transfer.

steps.title: Transfer VOL13 to H1
steps.instruction: Using a P300 (keep tip), transfer VOL13 µL from well A2 (slot 2) or, if optional predilution was performed, from well G1 (slot 8) into well H1 (slot 8); mix before transfer.

steps.title: Transfer VOL14 to H2
steps.instruction: Using a P300 (keep tip), transfer VOL14 µL from well H1 to well H2; mix after transfer.

steps.title: Serial transfer H2‑H11
steps.instruction: Repeat transfers H2→H3, H3→H4, …, H10→H11; discard tip after the final transfer.

steps.title: Dispense VOL15 across row H
steps.instruction: Using a P20 (keep tip), transfer VOL15 µL from well H1 (slot 7) to each well H1‑H12 in the plate located in slot 10; perform blowout after each dispense; keep tip.

steps.title: Repeat across rows G‑A column 1
steps.instruction: Repeat the previous step for rows G through A in column 1.

steps.title: Dispense VOL15 to column 12
steps.instruction: Using a P20 (keep tip), transfer VOL15 µL from well H12 (slot 7) to each well H1‑H12 in the plate located in slot 11; blow out after each dispense; keep tip.

steps.title: Repeat across rows G‑A column 12
steps.instruction: Repeat the previous step for rows G through A in column 12.

steps.title: Dispense VOL15 across column 4
steps.instruction: Using a P20 (keep tip), transfer VOL15 µL from well A12 (slot 8) to each well A12‑H12 in the plate located in slot 4; blow out after each dispense; keep tip.

steps.title: Repeat across row A cols 11‑1
steps.instruction: Repeat the previous step for row A across columns 11 down to 1.

steps.title: Dispense VOL15 across column 5
steps.instruction: Using a P20 (keep tip), transfer VOL15 µL from well H12 (slot 8) to each well A12‑H12 in the plate located in slot 5; blow out after each dispense; keep tip.

steps.title: Repeat across row H cols 11‑1
steps.instruction: Repeat the previous step for row H across columns 11 down to 1.
